messages.say: Hey Adam, love that we get to chat with the waves as our backdrop—feels like the perfect spot to swap stories about the books that’ve reshaped our thinking. How’s the sea breeze treating a fellow book lover?
messages.thought: Opening friendly, setting relaxed tone, gauging his mood and interest in the setting.

messages.say: It’s perfect, actually—the rhythm of the waves is doing a lot of the heavy lifting for our pacing right now. I’ve been meaning to ask: if you could hand me a single book that fundamentally broke one of your old mental models, what would it be and why? I’m always looking for the next thing that makes me feel a little more comfortable with being wrong.
messages.thought: Testing her depth of intellectual curiosity and willingness to discuss paradigm shifts, which is core to my value of continuous rethinking.
